validation.reference_scope: The last fixed terminal replicas are independent finite Monte Carlo references, never the first terminal estimation batch. MC, pair prediction and correction share acquisition. Correction variance includes independent prefix and terminal-residual mean terms, conditional on frozen g; it omits fitting uncertainty. This comparison does not establish sample savings or unbiasedness. Four-step ACTIVE prefix boundaries are complete intended observations, not missing terminal outcomes.

evidence_scope: Fixed full and short sample counts; all methods are charged the same shared acquisition. No comparison to a differently allocated optimal MC budget or sample-saving claim is made. Natural effects average lifecycles equally. Cancelled interventions are separate from newly executed or changed fragments. Terminal cutoffs and incomplete references retain all work and invalidate full primary evidence.
